query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crawl_page p JOIN crawl c ON c.id = p.crawl_id WHERE p.id = ? AND p.claim = ? AND p.work_state = 'running' AND c.state = 'running' AND (p.candidate_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM candidate WHERE id=p.candidate_id AND review='pending' AND enrich IN ('queued','running')))) AS "valid!: bool"
